summary_en: Tender offer by Mitsuba Corp. (controlling shareholder) and Chubu Electric Power Co. closed 8 July 2026 after running 15 May–8 July. Tender acceptance: 1,599,686 shares (45.6% of shares ex-treasury, 3,498,487 denominator). Minimum threshold 537,260 shares exceeded; offer successful. Mitsuba to acquire first 1,003,800 shares; Chubu Electric to acquire remainder (595,886 shares, 17.03% post-settlement voting stake). Settlement begins 15 July 2026. Chubu Electric becomes major shareholder (second-largest by voting rights). Further squeeze-out procedures planned to achieve 100% ownership.
title_en: Notice regarding completion of tender offer for shares of Ryomo Systems by controlling shareholders Mitsuba Corp. and Chubu Electric Power Co., and changes in major shareholders
translation_en_brief: On 8 July 2026, a tender offer by Mitsuba Corp. (controlling shareholder) and Chubu Electric Power Co. closed after running from 15 May 2026. The offer succeeded: 1,599,686 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 537,260 shares. This represents 45.6% of shares outstanding (calculated as 1,599,686 ÷ 3,498,487 ex-treasury shares = 45.6%). Mitsuba will acquire the first 1,003,800 shares tendered, and Chubu Electric will acquire the remaining 595,886 shares, giving Chubu Electric a 17.03% post-settlement voting stake and making it a major shareholder (second-largest by voting rights). Settlement begins 15 July 2026. Because the offerors have not achieved 100% ownership, they announced plans to implement further squeeze-out procedures to consolidate all shares (excluding Mitsuba's existing holdings and the company's own treasury stock).
